EXAM TRAP   A log nobody reads is not a control
Logging appears in almost every list of access controls, and it earns its place only if someone reviews it. A question describing extensive logging with no review is describing a detective control that detects nothing.

WORKED EXAMPLE   The pattern behind the example
Map the person's ACCESS to the four duties, not their job title.
Development and production must be separate, whatever the company's size.
Administrative passwords are a duty in themselves, and must be held and logged separately.
A control that is inconvenient is not therefore wrong.

EXAM TRAP   Exam view
A case describes who has which system access and asks for the weakness. Translate access into duties before answering: the ability to edit a database record is authorization and recording at once, whatever the person is called.
